newsitem.title: NICARAGUA: Nicaragua names Noel Sacasa finance minister.
newsitem.headline: Nicaragua names Noel Sacasa finance minister.

text.p: Nicaraguan President Arnoldo Aleman said on Friday he named Noel Sacasa the country's new finance minister and accepted the resignation of Francisco Lainez.
Aleman said central bank advisor Sacasa would be sworn in later in the day.
Lainez presented his resignation a month ago, but was persuaded to stay on, Aleman said.
Lainez was named finance minister in January, in a move that surprised analysts. Observers said Lainez did not fit in with the vision of younger members of Aleman's economic team.
A close advisor to central bank president Noel Ramirez, Sacasa recently led a revision to the nation's tax laws.
